tei:div.tei:p: grang sbyor ril nag drang nges brtag pa mu tig gi phreng ba bzhugs so// ༈ /rin chen grang sbyor ring bsrel rta ljang bdun// gangs can mkha' la 'dren mkhas mnyam nyid mtshan// rig gnas kun la mkhas pa shākya'i mchog /legs lam ston pa'i bshes gnyen rgyal gyur cig /sngon dus rgya gar 'phags yul du// gso dpyad 'bum pa zhes grags kyang*// sngon chad bod 'dir bsgyur ba med// sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa dang*// dpal ldan rgyud bzhi la sogs kyi// gnyen po stong dang gnyis mchis pa// kun gyi mchog gyur ril nag ste// deng sang rtsod dus mi ngan rnams// pho rgod rig pa'i kha lo pa// ngo tsha bral ba'i zol sbyor gyi// ril bu tshad ldan ma lags pas// sems can dga' zhig slu bar byed// 'bigs byed rang gar spyad pa'i mthus// klu gnyan sa bdag 'khrugs pa yi// kha rlangs mdze 'bras phol mig dang*// gcong chen sde bzhi la sogs pa// 'du ba'i nad rnams 'khrugs shing slong*// de 'dra'i nyes skyon spang ba'i phyir// ha ri tsandan brtags pa ltar// 'di ni legs par brtag bya ste// zol sbyor ril bu yin srid na// mkhas pas skye ba kun tu spongs// tshad ldan rin chen ril bu la// gser gyis blu zhing mos pa bskyed// de ni nad 'joms ril bu mchog /yin phyir dang du blang bar bya// brtag thabs 'di ltar shes bya ste// ṭaṅga na bsregs thal ba dang*// 'dre 'jigs thang chu bsres pa yi| |chu la zhag gsum sbangs pa yis// zhig na zol can ril bu yin// ma zhig na ni rin po che// ril nag tshad ldan yin par nges// des kyang nges pa ma rnyed na// da dung brtag pa'i thabs yod de// lau ṇa dang ni tsu ka dang*// ser tshur bsres te chu la sbyangs// ril bu bcug la a bo ṭes// ma ṇi brgya rtsa'i bar du btso// de nas bton te grang du gzhug /'jig na zol can ril bu yin| |de tshe 'od 'bar ma zhig na// ril nag tshad ldan yin par nges// 'di ni 'khrul med brtag thabs te// bden rdzun shes pas ston pa yin// yin min 'byed pa'i gdams pa yin// zab khyad 'don pa'i man ngag yin// zab phyir so na'i yon med par// kun la ston pa'i do gal med// zhes pa 'di ni yin min brtag pa'i thabs// gdams pa zab mo don chen tshig nyung 'di// zab gnad 'phral phug nges pa rnyed pa yi// dge slong dharma kīrtis sbyar ba'o// zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zab khyad do//
